decision.next_hypothesis: H014-SUB-006f: remove the extra per-request H2D profiling synchronization by measuring input transfer, gather and expert compute in one CUDA interval; preserve exact execution and test the unchanged 1.20x complete-layer gate.

hypothesis.prediction: One worker-level activation upload, device gather, grouped expert execution and one output download preserve exact batches 1/2/4/8, improve batch-8 complete-layer capacity >=1.20x versus H014-SUB-006c, retain >=80% resident throughput and do not increase tensor payload or messages.

inspection.actual_bottleneck: Buffered execution reduces batch-8 wall p50 from 21.03625 to 17.7114 ms and raises resident throughput retention from 70.579% to 82.542%, but misses the 1.20x comparator gate at 1.18772x. The batch-8 external phase remains 8.8357 ms; collective p50 is 7.42765 ms, critical worker device is 5.430496 ms and exposed coordination is 1.49645 ms. Gather plus expert compute is 5.399504 ms; the worker also performs a separate profiled H2D interval that synchronizes before gather/compute.
inspection.fixture_limitation: Three retained real boundaries are row-rotated; route overlap is real for this trace but not a production prompt distribution.
